facades.name: northwest (water front)
facades.note: Bearing corrected 317.5 -> 316.2 on 2026-10-20 to the built wall normal: the front runs (2.68, -52.18) -> (-110.6, 56.5) with outward normal (-0.6922, -0.7217), bearing 316.2. The rounded 317.5 is 1.3 deg off; over the 157 m front that drifts 3.6 m in depth, so the 3 m band cut the last 3.5 m of the wall mid-bay and counted the half-visible arch at the crop as a 0.5 m opening. At 316.2 the band covers the whole front: 43 boarded + 43 arch openings, all regular, 0 off-size.
